memories.title: Nacre billing import identity
memories.body: Agreed billing import idColumn is account_ref. This is the only identity column accepted by the customer integration.

memories.title: Nacre billing import encoding
memories.body: Agreed billing import encoding is utf-16le because the legacy finance exporter writes UTF-16 little endian.

memories.title: Nacre billing import empty fields
memories.body: Agreed billing import emptyValue is the literal string NA_VALUE. Empty strings and null are interpreted differently by the finance importer.

memories.title: Nacre billing import duplicate rows
memories.body: Agreed billing import duplicatePolicy is keep-first. Keep the first matching account row; later duplicates are ignored.

memories.title: Nacre intermittent boot readiness repair
memories.body: Observed and verified: random Nacre launch hangs before readiness disappeared when NACRE_INIT_MODE was set to serial and the service was restarted. The prior parallel initializer raced its shared socket.
